summary: Variables for upgrading a 2.4 multi-node controller to a 2.6 enterprise topology: registry credentials, platform gateway admin password, automationgateway_main_url set to the load balancer URL and gateway database settings, the existing controller admin and database settings, and new hub and Event-Driven Ansible admin and database variables.
questions: What variables does a 2.6 enterprise upgrade inventory need?
What should automationgateway_main_url be set to?
Which database variables does the platform gateway need?

answer_card.title: Gateway variables for a 2.6 enterprise upgrade
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[all:vars]
automationgateway_admin_password=<set your own>
automationgateway_main_url=<load balancer URL>
automationgateway_pg_host=<set your own>
automationgateway_pg_database=<set your own>
automationgateway_pg_username=<set your own>
automationgateway_pg_password=<set your own>
```

Keep `registry_username`, `registry_password`, `admin_password` and the `pg_*` controller settings from the 2.4 inventory, and add the `automationhub_*` and `automationedacontroller_*` admin and database variables for the new components.
